name: How should I prepare my home before interior finish work begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before interior finish work begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your finish contractor arrives, decide on key finish selections including door profiles, baseboard heights, paint colors, sheen levels, and tile patterns. Clear the work area of personal items, artwork, and furniture so crews have open wall space and cutting zones. It is also wise to inspect existing rooms for trim styles you wish to match, verify that HVAC is functioning to maintain a stable interior temperature for drywall drying and wood acclimation, and establish designated staging areas for saws and materials. Having these decisions and spaces prepared prevents unexpected delays once carpentry begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select your trim profiles and paint colors, clear furniture from the work zones, and ensure your heating or cooling system is running to stabilize indoor humidity.
